reports.title: Erasca Reports Third Quarter 2026 Business Updates and Financial Results

desk.headline: Loss widened to $0.15 a share, missed estimate; cash at $948m after July raise; no financial guidance; key ERAS-0015 trials set to start from 2027
results: Erasca has no product sales yet; the net loss grew to $51.3m ($0.15 a share) from $30.6m ($0.11), against an estimate of about -$0.13.
Research spending more than doubled to $47.2m as clinical trials, lab work and staff costs rose; G&A rose to $12.3m.
Cash and securities reached $947.8m, up from $341.8m at the end of 2025, after a July share offering that raised about $632.5m gross.
In August the FDA gave lead drug ERAS-0015 Fast Track status for metastatic pancreatic cancer.
A new president of R&D, Charles Fuchs, joined in August.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance. The company says its cash should fund the listed trial milestones, and it set out timelines: ERAS-4001 early data in H2 2026, ERAS-0015 expansion data in H1 2027, and three potentially registration-enabling trials starting from H1 2027.

points: CEO Jonathan Lim said ERAS-0015 could become a foundation therapy across RAS-mutant cancers, alone and in combinations.
He stressed fast progress toward three potentially registration-enabling trials in pancreatic and lung cancer.
Updated ERAS-0015 data and early combination lab data with ERAS-4001 are due at the ENA conference on 18–20 Nov 2026.
call.source: CEO comments in the press release (Exhibit 99.1); no call coverage found

watch: Updated ERAS-0015 data at the ENA meeting (18–20 Nov 2026) and first ERAS-4001 data promised for H2 2026.
Start of the lung cancer registration-enabling trial (H1 2027) and the pancreatic Phase 3 (2027).
Patent and trade-secret claims by Revolution Medicines over ERAS-0015, flagged as a risk in the release.
